blocks: A public astronomy e-commerce storefront. Customers browse a product catalog, add items to a cart, and check out through a synchronous order pipeline. Traffic is synthetic, driven by the load generator; faults are injected through flagd. Telemetry is OpenTelemetry throughout, scraped by Prometheus and traced through Jaeger.
